groups.name: Season
groups.description: Season pass, events, challenges, and editions.

components.name: Pass track
components.description: Season pass progress: current tier, XP to the next tier, the reward rail around it, and the next reward.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The standard size.

values.name: Compact
values.description: Hides the rail, next reward, and badge, shrinks the tier tile, and shows XP gained this match in the bar.

values.name: Default
values.description: Full card: tier tile, title and XP, premium badge, reward rail, progress bar, and the next reward.

slots.name: Tier
slots.description: The current tier number in the lime tile.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The pass name beside the tier.

slots.name: XP
slots.description: XP earned toward the next tier, as current over target.

slots.name: Reward
slots.description: The next reward and the tier that unlocks it.

components.accessibility: A region labeled "Season pass progress", read as tier, title, XP, a progress bar, and the next reward. The reward rail is hidden.
notes: Compact drops the reward rail and shows XP gained this match in bone over the lime base.

components.name: Event card
components.description: Live limited-time event over cropped key art, with a countdown and queue command.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The standard size.

values.name: Compact
values.description: Shorter card shaded from the left, with a smaller title and copy and the queue button at the end.

values.name: Default
values.description: Tall card over the key art, with badge and timer on top and title, copy, and queue button below.

slots.name: Timer
slots.description: Time left before the event ends.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The event name, uppercase in the display face.

slots.name: Description
slots.description: One line on what the event offers.

components.accessibility: An article read as the live badge, timer, title, and description, then the "Queue now" button. The key art is decorative.

components.name: Challenge row
components.description: Daily challenge with objective, progress, and XP reward. State encodes progress band.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Started
values.description: The progress bar fills a fifth of the track.

values.name: Halfway
values.description: The progress bar fills half the track.

values.name: Close
values.description: The progress bar fills four fifths of the track.

values.name: Complete
values.description: A full bar, with a lime border and tint, a lime glyph tile, and the reward in lime.

slots.name: Glyph
slots.description: Line icon for the challenge type, in the square tile.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The objective, cut to one line.

slots.name: Count
slots.description: Progress as done of total, beside the bar.

slots.name: Reward
slots.description: XP awarded on completion.

components.accessibility: Read in order as the objective, a progress bar with its count, and the XP reward. The glyph is hidden.

components.name: Squad member
components.description: Squadmate identity with presence, and match stats in scoreboard and MVP rows.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Online
values.description: Avatar with a presence dot, the handle, and a muted status line.

values.name: In match
values.description: The status line and presence dot turn amber while the player is in a match.

values.name: Scoreboard
values.description: A surface row with match stats on the right. The presence dot is hidden.

values.name: MVP
values.description: A scoreboard row with a lime edge and tint, a lime status line, and bold stats.

slots.name: Tag
slots.description: Player initials shown in the avatar.

slots.name: Name
slots.description: The player's handle, cut to one line.

slots.name: Status
slots.description: Presence or match role, such as In lobby or 6 assists.

slots.name: Stats
slots.description: Match figures, such as eliminations and damage, shown only in scoreboard and MVP rows.

components.accessibility: Read as the initials, handle, and status line, then the match stats when shown. The status text carries the presence.

components.name: Stat meter
components.description: One performance stat with a bar against the player average. Plain drops the frame and bar for headline figures.

uses.reason: The bar against the player average.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Above
values.description: The bar fills about three quarters in lime, and the comparison turns lime.

values.name: Average
values.description: The bar fills about half in the foreground color, with a muted comparison.

values.name: Below
values.description: The bar fills about a quarter in muted gray, with a muted comparison.

values.name: Record
values.description: A full lime bar, a lime comparison, and a lime border with a soft glow.

values.name: Plain
values.description: No frame, bar, or comparison. A larger figure sits above its label, for headline numbers.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: What the stat measures, uppercase in mono.

slots.name: Value
slots.description: The stat figure.

slots.name: Delta
slots.description: How the figure compares with the player's average.

components.accessibility: Plain text read as label, figure, and comparison. Assistive technology skips the bar, because the comparison says the same.

components.name: Edition card
components.description: Purchasable edition with price, perks, and a purchase command. Featured raises the card and swaps to the primary command.

uses.reason: Purchase commands. The featured variant shows the primary one.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Default
values.description: A bordered card with a muted kicker, gray perk markers, and the outline purchase button.

values.name: Featured
values.description: Lime border and glow, the Most chosen badge, a lime kicker and markers, and the primary button.

slots.name: Kicker
slots.description: The edition name above the price.

slots.name: Price
slots.description: The price, large in the display face.

slots.name: Note
slots.description: Billing terms beside the price, such as Forever.

slots.name: Perks
slots.description: A list of what the edition includes.

slots.name: CTA
slots.description: Label of the outline purchase button, shown in the default state.

slots.name: Featured CTA
slots.description: Label of the primary purchase button, shown in the featured state.

components.accessibility: An article read as the edition name, price and terms, a list of perks, then one purchase button. The Most chosen badge reads only when featured.

components.name: Mode tile
components.description: Game mode entry with index, line glyph, name, and rules summary.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Default
values.description: A muted index and glyph above the mode name and rules. On hover, the border and surface lift.

values.name: New
values.description: Shows the New mode badge and tints the glyph in the accent color.

slots.name: Index
slots.description: The mode's position in the list, as two digits.

slots.name: Glyph
slots.description: Line drawing for the mode, stretched across the tile.

slots.name: Name
slots.description: The mode name, uppercase in the display face.

slots.name: Meta
slots.description: A one-line rules summary.

components.accessibility: A link read as the index, mode name, and rules, plus the New mode badge when shown. The glyph is hidden.

components.name: Rank emblem
components.description: Competitive rank insignia: a hex plate tinted by rank tier with a division numeral.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only variant.

values.name: Default
values.description: The only size.

values.name: Bronze
values.description: The plate is tinted bronze, mixed from the warning and destructive colors.

values.name: Silver
values.description: The plate is tinted in the muted gray.

values.name: Gold
values.description: The plate is tinted in the warning color.

values.name: Diamond
values.description: The plate is tinted in the accent color.

values.name: Apex
values.description: The plate is tinted lime and glows, the only tier that does.

slots.name: Tier
slots.description: The division numeral on the plate, such as II.

components.accessibility: An image labeled with the full rank, such as "Diamond rank". The plate and numeral do not read separately.
notes: Rank tone comes from existing color roles, so a retheme recolors every tier.
Reserve the glow for the apex tier only.
implementationHints: Render it from the player rank model. The tier slot carries the division numeral, and the accessible name carries the full rank.
